Our History

Meridian Technologies has been at the forefront of innovation since its founding. What started as a small software consultancy has grown into a global technology leader.

Timeline

1998

Founded in a garage in Palo Alto by Maria Chen and David Okafor. Initial focus on database optimization consulting.

2003

Launched MeridianDB, our flagship distributed database product. Secured Series A funding of $5M from Sequoia Capital.

2008

Expanded to European markets. Opened offices in London and Berlin. Employee count surpassed 500.

2015

IPO on NASDAQ. Launched cloud-native platform MeridianCloud. Named to Forbes Cloud 100 list.

2023

Acquired DataStream Analytics for $2.1B. Launched AI-powered data platform. Revenue exceeded $4B annually.
